subject: Thank you for staying with us
message:
Dear {{name}},

Thank you for spending your time with us at Essência. It was a joy to have you here, and we hope you take a little of this place with you.

If you feel like sharing how your stay was, we would love to hear it. Your words help us grow:
{{feedbackLink}}

You are always welcome back. Until then, we wish you all the best on your way!

Com carinho,
Essência Nature Retreat
